title: Optional modules
description: Add SEO, gallery, reviews, and other core features to an existing client project after generation.

blocks.text: When you run tempjs hotel, you get the template as maintainers shipped it — including whatever core modules they enabled (hotel includes seo, gallery, reviews). For lean scaffold templates or older projects, you can add optional features later with tempjs add-module without re-copying the whole template.

blocks.title: Requires .tempjs.json
blocks.text: Run add-module from the project root where tempjs created .tempjs.json. It is not a maintainer-only command.

rows: Hero carousel from SITE.hero and hero image assets
Gallery CMS API, GallerySection, /gallery pages, admin gallery UI
Reviews API, ReviewsSection, admin reviews UI
Privacy policy and terms pages from SITE config
Compose Blog Engine, /blog pages, BlogSection, admin compose editor

items: Copies files from packages/core/modules/<id>/ into your project
Appends Prisma models to prisma/domain.prisma when the module needs them
Rebuilds prisma/schema.prisma from the core base + your domain models
Sets SITE.features.<flag> to true in constants/site.ts
For seo: wires SiteJsonLd into app/layout.tsx (keeps your custom metadata if already set)
Does not replace app/page.tsx or app/admin/page.tsx — import new sections yourself or use module admin components

blocks.code:
pnpm prisma db push
pnpm dev

blocks.text: Configure copy and behavior in constants/site.ts — e.g. SITE.gallery.*, SITE.reviews.*, SITE.seo.sitemap.staticRoutes. For enquiry-modal dropdown options from your listings API, set SITE.enquiry.listingsApiPath (e.g. /api/projects).

blocks.title: Hotel / real-estate templates
blocks.text: Shipped vertical templates already include domain features (rooms, projects) and adopted core modules where they overlapped bespoke code. You typically only need add-module on custom scaffold projects created with pnpm new-template --modules.

tempjs update --merge does not automatically install new core modules from upstream. If a template release adds a new optional module, run tempjs add-module <id> in the client project or merge module files manually.
